l2r_am_02_20260916_w0_challenge.instruction_en: Find the desk that initially holds the folder. First place the folder temporarily on the coffee table, then put the stapler under that desk, and finally return the folder to its original desk. Do not move the calculator on the coffee table.

l2r_mv_03_20260916_w0_challenge.instruction_en: Close all three initially open microwave doors, keeping the initially closed door closed until all three have been closed. Open the initially closed door for the next use only while the other three doors are currently all closed. Finish with those three doors closed and the spare door open.

l2r_mv_05_20260916_w0_challenge.instruction_en: Keep the initially on calculator running while turning on the initially off backup calculator. Turn off the original calculator only while the backup is currently on. Then turn off the backup. Finish with both calculators off.

Do not move either candidate destination object or the original surface used for temporary placement throughout the task.
